recap.text: Carl and Katia settle on a chain shaped like a dragon, drawn first in Donut's voodoo book for her approval. Donut grunts at the finished tattoo on his right forearm and calls it a little crooked, though the system rates it expert quality. When the mantaurs charge, Carl uses Profane Iron: chains tear from his skin, smash two Black Nimbus potions into two mantaurs, and rip a guard's head away.

beats.headline: A chain shaped like a dragon
beats.text: Katia sets a vial of ink on the table, already mixed, and Carl lays the poke and stick tattoo kit beside it. Li Na lost five levels temporarily but can still use the skill; intention matters, and with blood freely given, the potion allows the spell or skill to be chosen. The tattoo itself is permanent. A level-13 skill needs a big one and almost all the ink, and a properly themed design will last longer. Katia has never done a real tattoo, and Edgar is off scouting. Donut messages that it must be drawn in the voodoo book first for her approval. Carl's idea: a chain. A chain shaped like a dragon.
beats.gist: Katia mixes the ink, Carl sets out the kit, and Donut demands a drawn design first.

beats.headline: Expert quality
beats.text: Donut jumps into Carl's lap and examines the new, shining tattoo on his right forearm with a paw. She grunts. He is starting to look like one of those white rapper doodle notebook guys, she says, and it is a little crooked; she should have been there. It is not crooked, Carl tells her. The system says it is expert quality, which Edgar says is the second highest there is.
beats.gist: Donut examines Carl's new tattoo and calls it crooked, but Carl insists the system rates it expert quality.

beats.headline: Profane Iron
beats.text: As the mantaurs charge, Carl activates the skill he received from Li Na. Profane Iron. His skin tears as dozens of chains rip from his flesh, at a small cost to his health. Two chains pluck the Black Nimbus potions from his hands and smash them into two mantaurs; a third wraps round a neck, a fourth trips two more, and two strike scorpion-like into a guard's clavicles and rip his head away with part of his spine. The fight is over in seconds. It is a once-a-day skill: he gets about thirty seconds and two chains he can truly control, where Li Na gets ninety seconds and ten.
beats.gist: Carl activates Profane Iron, and chains tear from his skin to wreck the charging mantaurs in seconds.
